title: Maison de L’Asie Perfume: 3 Fragrances to Discover on Scentbird
summary: Discover 3 Maison de L’Asie perfumes on Scentbird, including L’Ibasho, Lost Lovers, and Mother Love, with notes and scent profiles.
body_markdown:
[Maison de L’Asie](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/maison-de-lasie) brings together French perfumery and Asian storytelling, creating fragrances inspired by the diverse cultures and philosophies of the continent. As Southeast Asia’s first luxury niche fragrance house, the Maison works with French perfumers to translate these stories into what it calls Olfactory Story Chapters, collections of unisex fragrances inspired by different countries and themes across Asia.


For this edition of[Scentbird Select](https://www.scentbird.com/scentbird-select) , we’re spotlighting three Maison de L’Asie fragrances, each offering a different interpretation of memory, love, belonging, and the passage of time.


## [MAISON DE L’ASIE L’Ibasho](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/maison-de-l-asie-l-ibasho-180180949487886)


Inspired by the idea of belonging, L’Ibasho is an introspective fragrance with a nostalgic quality. Sakura, cherry, and Turkish rose create a soft floral opening before rice and ink accords bring a more unexpected character to the composition. Finally, orris, talcum, and patchouli settle into a grounded finish that feels familiar and warm.


**Notes:** Japanese Cherry Blossom, Cherry, Turkish Rose, Rice, Ink, Orris Root, Talcum, Patchouli


## [MAISON DE L’ASIE Lost Lovers](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/maison-de-lasie-lost-lovers-3768)


Lost Lovers explores the passage of time, appealing to sentiments many of us have gone though. It opens with ush green notes before gradually becoming warmer with sandalwood and amber and finally, the smopkiness of vetiver. The result is a unisex fragrance that feels complex and sensual on the skin.


**Notes:** Myrtle, French Orange Blossom, Bergamot, Rose, Cedar, Jasmine, Violet, White Musk, Amber, Spices, Vetiver


## [MAISON DE L’ASIE Mother x Love](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/maison-de-lasie-mother-x-love-3769)


Airy and intimate, Mother x Love is built around the comforting feeling of returning to your happiest memories. Its delicate blend of white musk and white flowers make it the kind of fragrance you want close to you; rather than a dramatic entrance, its appeal is its intimacy and comfort.


**Notes:** Vanilla, Ginger, Lychee, Magnolia, Mandarin, Jasmine, Pepper, Saffron, Musk, Suede, Jasmine


Discover these Maison de L’Asie fragrances on[Scentbird](https://www.scentbird.com/) and experience each scent on your skin before deciding which story belongs in your fragrance collection.
